title: Shared Stats (Source of Truth)

fields.label: Customer/user count (display value)
fields.name: global_customer_count_value
fields.instructions: e.g. "600,000+". Update this ONE field when the number changes — every 'sea' page and (recommended) the ad-copy generation process should read from here instead of hardcoding the number.

fields.label: Supporting trust fact
fields.name: global_customer_count_supporting_fact
fields.instructions: e.g. "9 of the 10 biggest audit firms"

fields.label: Headline cost-reduction stat
fields.name: global_cost_reduction_stat
fields.instructions: e.g. "Up to 80%". This is the single source for hero_stat across pages that don't override it.

fields.label: Problem-section stats (shared, page-agnostic)
fields.name: global_problem_stats
fields.instructions: The 3-5 sourced pain-point stats reused across every 'sea' page per brief requirement 4. Edit here once.

fields.label: Stat citation
fields.name: global_stat_citation
fields.default_value: Aberdeen, Arthur D. Little, BVA, IOFM, Levvel

fields.label: Compliance / security badges
fields.name: global_compliance_badges
fields.instructions: SOC 2, GDPR, etc. Leave empty until Legal/Security confirms current certification status and provides the badge asset — do NOT publish a placeholder badge as if it were verified.

_comment: Register the options page itself with acf_add_options_page(['page_title' => 'Shared Landing Page Stats', 'menu_slug' => 'acf-options-shared-stats']) in the theme's functions.php (or a small must-use plugin) before importing this group.

fields.label: Primary keyword phrase
fields.name: primary_keyword_phrase
fields.instructions: e.g. "AP Automation", "Sage AP Automation", "Accounts Payable Automation". Must appear literally in the H1 (enforced by template, not by this field).

fields.label: Secondary keyword phrase (optional)
fields.name: primary_keyword_phrase_secondary
fields.instructions: Only used on the general/brand page, which must cover both "AP Automation" and "Accounts Payable Automation" phrasing per brief requirement 1.

fields.label: Segment name
fields.name: segment_name
fields.instructions: ERP name (Sage, Epicor, Dynamics, CDK, Karmak, ProcedeSoftware) or industry vertical (Construction, Automotive, Trucking). Leave empty for the general/brand page.

fields.label: Hero eyebrow
fields.name: hero_eyebrow
fields.instructions: Small pink line above the H1, per brand refresh hero pattern.

fields.label: Subhead
fields.name: subhead
fields.instructions: Carries the free-demo / no-risk promise. Never mention a free trial — only a free demo exists.

fields.label: Hero stat — value
fields.name: hero_stat_value
fields.instructions: Defaults to global_cost_reduction_stat from Shared Stats; override only with a verified page-specific number.

fields.label: HubSpot form ID
fields.name: hubspot_form_id
fields.instructions: e.g. 1b3ffee0-1aa1-4f18-9073-db1d433a3dff. Verify whether segment pages route to a dedicated form before assuming the general page's form ID.

fields.label: Post-submit microcopy
fields.name: cta_after_submit_microcopy
fields.default_value: A specialist reaches out within one business day to schedule your live demo.

fields.label: Problem section heading
fields.name: problem_heading
fields.default_value: The Real Cost of Manual AP

fields.label: Problem stats override (optional)
fields.name: problem_stats_override
fields.instructions: Leave empty to inherit global_problem_stats from Shared Stats. Only fill in if this specific segment has its own validated stats.

fields.label: Integration / ERP logos
fields.name: integration_logos
fields.instructions: Segment-aware: when segment_name is an ERP, feature that ERP's logo first/larger via field_integration_logo_featured below rather than relying on grid order alone.

fields.label: Featured ERP logo (if segment is an ERP)
fields.name: integration_logo_featured

fields.label: Benefit statements
fields.name: benefit_statements
fields.instructions: Each must tie to a fact established elsewhere on the page or in Shared Stats — no unsupported superlatives (no "#1", "most powerful", "only") without a citable source in the linked_fact field.

sub_fields.label: Linked fact / source
sub_fields.name: linked_fact
sub_fields.instructions: Which stat elsewhere on this page (or in Shared Stats) backs this claim?

fields.label: Client logos band heading
fields.name: client_logos_heading
fields.instructions: No unsupported ranking superlatives (see brief WHAT NOT TO DO) unless a citable source is attached.

fields.label: Meta description
fields.name: meta_description
fields.instructions: No unsupported superlatives. Should contain the primary_keyword_phrase and the verified cost-reduction stat.
